jsonld.description: Family owned tile and marble installation company serving Naples and Southwest Florida: kitchen backsplashes, shower tile, floor tile replacement and marble work.

script.es: Padre e hijo, 20 anos de oficio.
script.en: Father and son, 20 years of craft.

parrafo.es: Backsplash de cocina, pisos de ceramica, duchas de marmol: Jacob y John instalan azulejo en Naples y el suroeste de Florida con mas de 20 anos de experiencia familiar.
parrafo.en: Kitchen backsplashes, ceramic floors, marble showers: Jacob and John install tile across Naples and Southwest Florida with over 20 years of family experience.

parrafo_1.es: Casza Renovation Tile & Marble Services es un negocio familiar con mas de 20 anos de experiencia instalando azulejo y marmol en Naples, Bonita Springs, Estero y el resto del suroeste de Florida.
parrafo_1.en: Casza Renovation Tile & Marble Services is a family owned business with over 20 years of experience installing tile and marble across Naples, Bonita Springs, Estero and the rest of Southwest Florida.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes repiten lo mismo: Jacob y John son limpios, eficientes y se comunican en cada paso del trabajo. Un equipo pequeno que trata cada casa como propia.
parrafo_2.en: Our customers say the same thing again and again: Jacob and John are clean, efficient, and communicate through every step of the job. A small crew that treats every home like their own.
